title: Who sets it down
topic: Robots and AI checks assemble solar tables on a factory line in the field at the 457 megawatt Tormes Solar project in Navarro County, and workers still set each table on its supports.
hook: Robots build it. Who sets it down?

treatment.logline: Near Barry, a factory parked in a field builds solar tables with robots and an AI check, and a crew member still sets each one down.
treatment.cold_open: A rover with a face brakes at a row of bare steel posts carrying a finished solar table. Its eyes look up at a crew member in a hardhat, and before second three she steps in with her gloves up.
treatment.turn: The rover stops at the posts and can't set the table down. Gloved hands do it, while a dashed blueprint of a future robot arm mirrors her moves beside her, still unbuilt.
treatment.button: The table she set down tilts toward the sun. The robots build the table, and a person sets it down.

hero.name: the panel gantry robot

scenes.vo: Near Barry, in Navarro County, robots now do the heavy lifting on part of a solar farm. A person still has to set each piece down.

draw.subject: a rover carrying a finished solar table
draw.action: brakes beside bare steel posts and its eyes look up at the crew member
draw.emotion: she steps in with her gloves up, determined

draw.subject: the table on the rover
draw.action: rocks as the rover stops and a spark burst pops

draw.subject: a map pin
draw.action: drops on the field beside rows of empty steel posts
draw.emotion: she looks out at the posts, determined

scenes.vo: The project is Tormes Solar, 457 megawatts, built by the contractor SOLV Energy for Matrix Renewables. Building it is expected to support about 450 jobs.

draw.subject: a site sign
draw.action: swings up on its posts as the crew walk past it

draw.subject: the 457 counter
draw.action: counts up over rows of posts stretching to the horizon

draw.subject: two crew members
draw.action: stride down a row of posts with a tablet

draw.subject: a crowd of crew members
draw.action: fills the row behind her, hardhats bobbing
draw.emotion: she turns and grins at them

scenes.vo: On most solar farms, crews set steel tubes in the field first. Then workers lift heavy glass panels onto them, one by one, hundreds of thousands of them.

draw.subject: two workers
draw.action: heave a glass panel up onto a tube already standing in the field

draw.subject: the two workers
draw.action: heave the panel up the last few inches onto the tube

draw.subject: a second panel
draw.action: slides down off the tube and they catch it

draw.subject: a mountain of panel crates
draw.action: towers up out of the field until it dwarfs the crew member
draw.emotion: she tips her hardhat back, stunned

scenes.vo: So Terabase Energy, a company from Berkeley, California, flipped the order. It parks a factory line right in the field.

draw.subject: the two step diagram
draw.action: flips over so the table is built first and carried out second

draw.subject: the factory line
draw.action: rolls in on wheels and unfolds its canopy in the field

scenes.vo: On that line, robots fasten the panels onto a long steel tube, called a torque tube. The finished piece is a solar table. For now, the line is optimized for one panel and one tracker, made by First Solar and Nextpower.

draw.subject: the gantry robot
draw.action: lowers panel after panel onto the tube, each one clicking down
draw.emotion: its visor eyes narrow in focus

draw.subject: the steel tube
draw.action: rolls a quarter turn under the panels as a ring of light runs along it

draw.subject: the finished table
draw.action: slides along the line past the crew member

draw.subject: the gantry robot
draw.action: lowers toward an odd panel, stops short and shakes its head

draw.subject: the gantry robot
draw.action: turns away an odd panel, then grabs the right one with happy eyes

scenes.vo: Then AI-assisted tools check every unit, so a panel in the wrong spot gets caught right away.

draw.subject: a scan box
draw.action: sweeps panel by panel along the table, turning each one green

draw.subject: one crooked panel
draw.action: flashes amber, the robot nudges it square and it turns green
draw.emotion: she checks it on her tablet and smiles

scenes.vo: Terabase says one line runs on a two minute cycle. Running around the clock, that is more than 20 megawatts a week.

draw.subject: an hourglass on the line
draw.action: flips, and a finished table slides out toward the camera on every flip

draw.subject: the sky
draw.action: spins from day to night and back while tables keep stacking

draw.subject: a stack of tables
draw.action: piles up beside the 20 counter as it lands with a hit

scenes.vo: Next, a robot loads the table onto a rover, and the rover drives it out into the field. Tormes is the first site where this version runs with autonomous rovers.

draw.subject: the gantry
draw.action: sets the green table onto the rover's deck and the rover bounces under the weight

draw.subject: the rover
draw.action: rolls off down the row like an airport shuttle

draw.subject: a line of rovers
draw.action: follows the first one down the row like ducklings

scenes.vo: Here is the fair doubt. This is a proof of concept on a portion of the project. Those speed figures are the company's own, and it says real output depends on the site.

draw.subject: the yellow factory line
draw.action: shrinks to a small patch at the edge of a huge field of bare posts
draw.emotion: she squints out at it from the foreground

draw.subject: a stamp
draw.action: slams PROOF OF CONCEPT onto the small patch

draw.subject: a magnifier
draw.action: slides over the fine print under the big two minute number
draw.emotion: she squints at it and shrugs

scenes.vo: The robots also stop short. Workers unload each table and set it on the steel supports waiting in the field.

draw.subject: the rover
draw.action: brakes beside the empty posts and waits
draw.emotion: its eyes look up at her, hopeful

draw.subject: two workers
draw.action: guide the table down onto its posts and it locks in
draw.emotion: she grits her teeth then grins

draw.subject: her gloved hands
draw.action: press the table flat on the bearing until it clicks

scenes.vo: Terabase says it is building robots for that last step too.

draw.subject: a dashed blueprint robot arm
draw.action: draws itself beside her and copies her every move

scenes.vo: The farm is expected to start running in the first half of 2027. Until then, the robots build the table, and a person sets it down.

draw.subject: the table she set down
draw.action: tilts on its posts to face the sun as the sun smiles back

draw.subject: the sun
draw.action: beams wider as a glint runs across the tilted panels

draw.subject: a whole row of tables
draw.action: tilts together toward the sun behind her
draw.emotion: she rests a hand on the table, smiling
